name: bm-text-normalization-benchmark
description: The bm-text-normalization-benchmark evaluates models on written-to-spoken text normalization for the 'bm' language (ISO code 'bm'), focusing on converting numerals, dates, abbreviations and other non-standard tokens into their normalized spoken forms. It provides input–target pairs for training and evaluating sequence-to-sequence normalization systems, intended for TTS preprocessing and low-resource multilingual normalization research.
evaluation_method: exact_match / accuracy (token- or utterance-level exact match)
reputation: Niche dataset mainly used in text-normalization and low-resource TTS research; limited broad adoption.
